items.topic: Rackinspect error model: one general BusinessError fault declared on every failing operation
items.claim: Docs lack a real-world fault modelling pattern
items.fact: Rackinspect model/rackinspect.model declares three fault transfer objects: error_services::BusinessError (code, message; String, required, TRANSIENT; 141 <faults> uses on deletes, workflow, AI, PDF ops), entities::GenericOperationError (operation, details; 33 uses, mostly toggleActive/togglePrimary), FaultRegistryUploadError (code, message, location ids; 1 use for bulk upload to keep per-row errors). No error-code enum; codes are plain Strings (ErrorCode is a master-data entity, not an enum). Pattern: one generic code+message carrier declared on every operation that can fail.

items.topic: Custom operation must declare <faults> or SDK lacks throws clause
items.claim: Docs have zero hits for faults/throws
items.fact: A custom-implemented operation needs an explicit fault parameter (<faults> targeting the fault TO) in the ESM model; without it the generated SDK omits `throws BusinessErrorException` and Maven fails with 'not compatible with throws clause'. Rules were only discoverable from generated SDK source. Also: operation whose output DTO matches the action-container view root breaks frontend generator (nonexistent *OutputView); fix by dropping output / making void.

items.topic: Rackinspect ExceptionUtils factory pattern (project code, not platform)
items.claim: Docs present ExceptionUtils / GenericOperationErrorException as platform API
items.fact: ExceptionUtils lives in Rackinspect common/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/rackinspect/common/utils/ExceptionUtils.java (public interface, static): createValidationException(location, code) / (List<ValidationResult>), createValidationResult, createBusinessException(operation, details)->GenericOperationErrorException, createBusinessErrorException(code, details)->BusinessErrorException (362 call sites, default), createFaultRegistryUploadError(code,message[,location,headerLocalId,faultLocalId]) (13 sites). Rule: never `new` an exception inline; use factory with code string constant (e.g. TicketingGuards.TICKETING_ROLE_FORBIDDEN) and i18n message from RackInspectI18n. These are project code to copy, generated types come from project's own fault TOs.

items.topic: Interceptors cannot throw modeled faults; wrap in InterceptorCallBusinessException
items.fact: Interceptors throw ValidationException (field rule, location = attribute name), InterceptorCallBusinessException(type, code, Map.of("message",..), null, locale) for permission/business refusals, never BusinessErrorException/GenericOperationErrorException; caught BusinessErrorException from services is rethrown as IBCE (ElementFaultUpdateInterceptor:82, ErrorQualificationInstanceDeleteInterceptor:110, RegistryHeaderUpdateInterceptor:69). WriteGuardSupport.requirePermitted uses ERROR_CODE=MASTER_DATA_WRITE_FORBIDDEN. Runtime turns IBCE into a _fault payload, DefaultDispatcher.java:764 converts to BusinessException. Rackinspect passes the interceptor/guard name as `type`, which matches no frontend translation; recommended: put the fault FQN as type and code+message in details so generated fault dialog works.

items.topic: OperationCallInterceptors do not fire on custom/mapped operations
items.fact: Interceptors (incl. write guards) fire only for behaviour operations (CRUD/list/refresh/range/reference). Custom and MAPPED operations (User.toggleActive, createUser, resendInvitation, changeRoles) bypass them; guards must sit inside each *CustomImplementation. Hiding UI buttons does not protect either.

items.topic: Non-attribute errors: use code+message BusinessError, not location-less ValidationResult
items.claim: unclear how to report cross-entity/permission/state/external errors
items.fact: In Rackinspect every production ValidationResult .location() is a model attribute name; non-attribute errors become BusinessError code+message (or IBCE). Readiness checks are returned as FaultRegistryValidationResult list rather than thrown (commit 8cb4f0b: 'readiness failures recorded and returned; business rules still throw'). Fail loudly rather than silent no-op (a982b7b: AI_PROCESSING_SWITCHED_OFF).

items.topic: Frontend: location-less 400 validation errors are dropped/generic; custom 422 override
items.fact: Default handler src/utilities/error-handling.ts: 500 toast judo.error.internal-server-error; 422 -> openFaultDialog(key,data[key]) rendering faults.<prefix>.<faultObjectKey>.<attribute> i18n keys (defaultValue = attribute name); 400 -> generic judo.error.validation-failed toast, field map only if errorList[0].location exists (:165). Location-less items fall under key '' so no field shows them; custom interceptor path (operationValidationFeedback.ts:59,100) filters them. Only 3 codes translated by default in en-US (REQUIRED_GROUP_MUST_HAVE_AT_LEAST_ONE_ROW, REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED), other codes fall back to raw code string (error-handling.ts:206-210). Rackinspect overrides via src/custom/hooks/register-error-handler-interceptor.ts (registered in custom/application-customizer.tsx:240): intercepts ALL 422s and shows 3s snack with data[firstKey].message, bypassing fault dialog. useCRUDDialog.tsx:155-170 still renders faults.* directly.

items.claim: INTERCEPTORS.md L682: ElementFaultUpdateInterceptor throws ValidationException; L70/175: UserRolesChangeInterceptor throws IllegalStateException; L845: createBusinessException returns GenericOperationErrorException (named createBusinessException); L834 ExceptionUtils in utils/
items.fact: ElementFaultUpdateInterceptor catches BusinessErrorException and rethrows IBCE; AGENTS.md of user/roles says ValidationException via requireConsistent (code throws IllegalStateException:67); ExceptionUtils is in the `common` module; factory for BusinessErrorException is createBusinessErrorException. CUSTOM-OPERATIONS.md L165 says RuntimeException for rate failures, contradicting its typed rule; several AGENTS.md (companyaddress:14, useraddress:16) say use createBusinessException (GenericOperationError) while the guide says BusinessErrorException.

items.topic: Rackinspect error handling anti-patterns (downgrade to 500, swallowed causes)
items.fact: Avoid: catch(GenericOperationErrorException) -> throw new RuntimeException(e) (UserRolesChangeInterceptor:73, UserManagementServiceImpl:208) downgrades to 500; KeycloakUserServiceImpl:62 and PDF preview/exchange-rate paths throw RuntimeException; WriteGuardSupport:119 turns DB failure into 'forbidden'; UserManagementServiceImpl:196 catch(Exception){allowed=false} no log; IllegalStateException for business invariants gives 500; createValidationException with translated message in the code arg for not-found cases. External failures should be wrapped into BusinessError and cause logged.

items.topic: Guice default leaks stack traces to client on 500
items.fact: With Guice both returnRuntimeExceptions-style flags default to true so every 500 sends the stack trace to the client; terminateOnException is never read; async interceptor postCall calls preCall and async interceptors lose exceptions and run outside the transaction.

items.topic: Interceptor combination semantics, range interceptors as security boundary
items.fact: Multiple OperationCallInterceptors on one operation: each preCall receives original payload, sees others' in-place payload mutations, return value accumulated last-non-null-wins. Range interceptors only fire on _getRangeReference* ops (not plain list/query ops like Rack/availableRackElements/~list); they are the security boundary for rangeType=ANY lean TOs since read-only attrs don't stop enumeration (incl. AI actor). Model min/max bounds are UI-only and don't reject server updates.

items.topic: Known generated DAO bugs: query<Attribute>() on enum, derived attribute via inherited member missing JOIN
items.fact: query<Attribute>() on an enumeration attribute always throws (enum ordinal/cast bug; workaround read via DTO or <Enum>.getByOrdinal; fix: apply ordinal conversion in query fragment). A derived attribute navigating through an inherited member produces a missing JOIN. Absent/null/empty: set<Relation> needs an object and unset clears; filter 'not set' with JQL !isUndefined(); getters follow `required`. Full CRUD DAO only generated for mapped non-abstract types.
